clips.title: HIP walk forward
clips.passCriterion: Keep the current timing. Cut the vertical bounce, the side travel, and the barrel yaw so the lows, the recovery, and the left travel match the reference.
clips.detail: Standing r1 score is 64, fail. The tile stays maker-only until a new render of changed motion is posted.

clips.title: HIP walk backward
clips.passCriterion: Sway side to side like the reference instead of pumping up and down. Match the reference drop near 0.45s.
clips.detail: Standing r1 score is 41, fail. The clock means this one is in review. No new score until a new render is posted.

clips.title: HIP strafe left
clips.passCriterion: Keep the loop timing. Shorten the rightward travel, reduce the inward roll, and lift the dip at 0.35 to 0.45s and 1.16 to 1.26s.
clips.detail: Standing r1 score is 58, fail. The tile stays maker-only until a new render of changed motion is posted.

clips.title: HIP strafe right
clips.passCriterion: Travel left around 0.30s and right around 0.60s. Replace the up-down bob.
clips.detail: Standing r1 score is 46, fail. The clock means this one is in review. No new score until a new render is posted.

clips.title: Forward ADS v4, phase-aligned comparison
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk, sights locked on center, almost no side yaw, and a tighter vertical bounce.
clips.detail: ADS v4 over the unchanged HIP forward baseline.

clips.title: Backward ADS v4, phase-aligned comparison
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk backward, sights locked on center, and a path that reads as backward instead of a wide figure-8.
clips.detail: ADS v4 over the unchanged HIP backward baseline.

clips.title: Left ADS v4, phase-aligned comparison
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe left, sights locked on center, and no rightward overshoot.
clips.detail: ADS v4 over the unchanged HIP left baseline.

clips.title: Right ADS v4, phase-aligned comparison
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe, sights locked on center, a rightward path with no left overshoot, and a fast shallow bounce.
clips.detail: ADS v4 over the unchanged HIP right baseline.

clips.title: Forward ADS v5 trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Restore a dedicated ADS forward walk with the reference's shallow footfall and cadence. The bottom is nearly still.
clips.detail: ADS v5 trial 1 over unchanged HIP r1. Fail 51. Sight stays on center. The walk pulse is missing. Not committed.
